items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: Oh, that thing we did with Sammy Davis, man, that was, I'm surprised that record came out all right... we played all those numbers down, and they put it out.

ctx.x: I don't see Arthur Prysock on here. Let me see. With, well, Sammy Davis, and I'm looking at a list of songs as a whole.

Oh, that thing we did with Sammy Davis, man, that was, I'm surprised that record came out all right, see, because Sammy liked to have a lot of people come and follow him around, you know. And we did this thing at 12 o'clock midnight at a theater in Detroit, after everybody left. And he came in there with his entourage and they had whiskey glue. Uh-oh. And they were drinking at some time, and they were sitting down there, and they was talking, and they had to stop the record, making the record to make another tape…
He probably always had to do that.
